rehydrationInstructions: Get the native template by UUID again through Dapta MCP. Replace the entire native api_action with template_data, then restore custom_action.values, on_error, and response mappings from the draft.
Preserve native custom_action.attributes, dynamicLoad, selector configuration, template_id, and from_template. Never save raw catalog URLs containing credentials to this repository.
Replace agent_id with the UUID of the new welcome voice agent. Never reuse the Cobranza agent. Confirm the new agent is linked to an allowed outbound caller.
Validate again, then preview with auto_layout=all. This draft does not authorize committing or executing a flow.

Before previewing the identity patch, hydrate only qryId Authorization with the private DAPTA_WELCOME_VOICE_IDENTITY_FLOW_TOKEN from an authorized source. Never write that value to Git, voice tools, call variables, exports or logs. Deploy the authenticated backend/parser before publishing the new flow and tool contract.

identityBackend.auth: Private Authorization Bearer DAPTA_WELCOME_VOICE_IDENTITY_FLOW_TOKEN, configured only in the Dapta HTTP node and FINSERPAY. The backend authenticates in constant time, resolves this event's ledger snapshot only in DISPATCHING/ACCEPTED/UNKNOWN within 24 h and enforces at most three identity attempts. No private bearer reaches voice tools, dynamic call variables or exports.
identityBackend.success: ok=true, verificado=true, condiciones object with complete speech; nextAction=CONTINUE, code=null, question=null, mayEndCall=false, remainingAttempts integer 0..2
identityBackend.mismatch: ok=true, verificado=false, condiciones=null; nextAction=ASK_NAME|ASK_DOCUMENT|REVIEW, remainingAttempts integer 0..2, fixed question and strict mayEndCall
identityBackend.failure: ok=false, verificado=false, condiciones=null, code=IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE; nextAction/remainingAttempts/question/mayEndCall=null. Do not invent a recovery action.
envelopes: Body object with an own args object; identity fields must not appear in both locations
identityBackend.invalidEnvelope: Malformed, mixed or missing/invalid-event input throws before the ERP request. The agent must not speak financial conditions without verified backend conditions.

speech.installmentCount: non-empty string with count and frequency
speech.installmentAmounts: non-empty array of non-empty strings, canonical one per installment from the same snapshot

identityBackend.legacySignedTokenMode: The backend retains per-event HMAC event_token mode for compatibility; this new identity flow does not send event_token. The original signed token stays in the native call for the authenticated result callback.
identityBackend.documentInput: Literal customer utterance, numeric text or spoken Spanish blocks/digits, up to 240 characters. A deterministic backend parser preserves leading zeros; it never chooses or completes a value using the expected document.
identityBackend.nameVerification: Private event flow: at least one exact significant registered name/surname component matches a whole provided component after case/accent normalization; exclude de/del/la/las/los/y. Exact full document is always mandatory. No fuzzy matching, substrings or expected-identity disclosure. Legacy signed-token matching remains unchanged.
identityBackend.documentClarification: DOCUMENT_NOT_UNDERSTOOD consumes the persisted three-consultation budget. Follow server ASK_DOCUMENT once; repeated unparsed document becomes REVIEW. A corrected document may proceed to ASK_NAME when no registered component matches and that clarification remains available.

questions.ASK_NAME: ¿Me repite su nombre completo, por favor?
questions.ASK_DOCUMENT: ¿Me repite su número de cédula, por favor?
questions.REVIEW: No pude confirmar sus datos. Un asesor revisará su caso.

identityClarification.waiting: ASK_* has mayEndCall=false and remainingAttempts 1..2; ask exactly question, wait, update only that literal field and reuse the same event.
identityClarification.terminal: REVIEW has remainingAttempts=0 and mayEndCall=true; no further consultation or financial conditions.
identityClarification.success: CONTINUE may succeed on consultation three; full verified speech and exact control contract required.
identityClarification.privacy: Never include expected identity, match details, tokens or financial conditions in an unverified response.

identitySource: The customer's actual full name and literal document utterance during the call. Expected identity values stay outside the voice agent's initial context. The authenticated backend resolves the scoped event snapshot and requires the exact normalized document.

dispatcherReceipt.location: Dapta HTTP response.response (runtime wrapper), or direct response body if available
dispatcherReceipt.rule: A native result.call_id produces boolean ok=true only after recursive rejection of error/errors/node_errors, explicit ok=false/success=false, and failed statuses in every sibling or wrapper. HTTP 200 alone is never acceptance. Unknown response must not trigger a duplicate customer call.

limitations: Native call receipt shape has not been live-tested; unknown native output is conservatively rejected.
This transport revision has not been committed or executed in Dapta. Static drafts do not authorize publishing or customer calls.
Dapta public route URLs and preview tokens are intentionally not included.

The guide documents response_params mapping but does not guarantee interpolation types. Code exports genuine booleans; the exact dynamic HTTP response type is not live-tested, so the dispatcher requires strict boolean true.
financialConditionsSource: Only backend conditions after nextAction=CONTINUE, strict ok=true/verificado=true, complete control fields and complete speech. The agent reads speech literally and never converts financial values. Native call receives no expected identity or financial conditions.

preparedLivePatches.scope: Four response-only operations: qryId exports, chkId strict validator/exports, rspId dynamic response. Preserve input, normalization, private credentials, endpoint, node identifiers and financial speech guard.

Eight compatible input strings and normalized exports; only event_id, credito_id and event_token reach the voice agent. Name and document are collected from the customer. Existing template, caller and agent identifiers unchanged.

pronunciation.identityToolSource: Actual customer name and literal document utterance; event_id is the exact scoped call variable. No expected identity, spoken snapshots or signed event token is copied by the model.
